title: SREV-006B service broker name shape

openservicew_shape.description: OpenServiceW accepts lpServiceName as LPCWSTR; service object name maximum length is 256 characters; SCM rejects invalid names

wire_layout.description: SERVICE_START_REQ and SERVICE_QUERY_REQ carry ULONG name_len plus WCHAR name[1] inline counted by h.length

name_gate_owner.description: Service_CheckName(msg_len, offset, name_len, name) enforces name_len <= 256, offset <= msg_len, (name_len+1)*sizeof(WCHAR) inside message, name[name_len] == L'\0' before OpenServiceW

policy_invariant.description: Service authorization and SCM access masks are unchanged; only the name shape is gated

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: malformed broker messages return ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER; normal service start/query requests still work

contracts: OpenServiceW lpServiceName maximum length is 256 characters
DLL caller sends name_len = wcslen(name) and includes the terminating WCHAR in h.length
Service-name gate must require (name_len+1)*sizeof(WCHAR) bytes inside the received message
Service-name gate must require name[name_len] == L'\0' before OpenServiceW
Start-service and query-service handlers both call Service_CheckName before OpenServiceW
OpenServiceW is not called for unterminated or overlong names
